metaTitle: Ceiling Fan Installation in Inglewood, CA | Cost & Info
metaDescription: Ceiling fan installation in Inglewood runs $235 to $335. Learn what's involved, when to call an electrician, and what affects the price.
intro: If you're noticing a room in your Inglewood home stays hot with no airflow, or an old fixture is on its way out, installing a ceiling fan is a common upgrade. This job is especially frequent in Inglewood's older single-family homes, where original ceiling boxes often weren't built to support a fan, and in renovated rentals where new owners want central lighting swapped out for fans.
causes: Older homes in Inglewood often have a light fixture box in the ceiling rather than a fan-rated box, which isn't strong enough to hold a spinning fan safely.
Renovated rental units sometimes have wiring or switches updated for lighting only, without the extra wiring needed for fan speed and light controls.
Homeowners frequently want a fan added to a bedroom or living room that never had one, especially in houses built before central air conditioning was standard.
An existing fan may be worn out, wobbling, or making noise, which usually means the mounting bracket or motor needs replacing.
Some ceilings have no electrical box at all in the desired location, requiring new wiring to be run from the nearest source.
whatProDoes: Turns off power at the breaker and confirms the circuit is dead before touching any wiring.
Inspects the existing ceiling box and replaces it with a fan-rated box if the current one isn't strong enough to support the fan's weight and movement.
Assembles the fan according to the manufacturer's instructions and mounts it securely to the ceiling joist or brace.
Connects the wiring for the fan motor, light kit, and any wall controls, then tests the fan on all speeds and the light on all settings.
Balances the fan blades if needed and cleans up the work area before leaving.
diyOrPro: Basic fan replacement using an existing fan-rated box and matching wiring is sometimes attempted by confident homeowners, but this still involves working with live electrical circuits at height. If your home has an older, non-fan-rated ceiling box, no box at all, or unusual wiring like Inglewood's mix of original and updated systems, this becomes a job for a licensed electrician to avoid fire risk or a fan falling from the ceiling.
priceNote: Ceiling fan installation in Inglewood costs $235 to $335, based on a $100 per hour rate for a typical 2 to 3 hour job. The time and cost depend mainly on whether the existing ceiling box needs to be replaced with a fan-rated one and how much wiring work is required, which varies a lot between Inglewood's older original homes and its recently renovated rental units.

faqs.q: Do I need a special ceiling box for a fan, or can it use my current light fixture box?
faqs.a: Most standard light fixture boxes, especially in older Inglewood homes, aren't rated to hold the weight and motion of a ceiling fan. An electrician typically needs to install a fan-rated box, which is included in the estimated time and cost.

faqs.q: Can I install a ceiling fan myself to save money?
faqs.a: It's possible if you already have a fan-rated box and matching wiring, but it involves working with live circuits overhead, and mistakes can lead to a fan falling or electrical fire. If your home is older or has been rewired during a renovation, it's safer to hire a licensed electrician.

faqs.q: Why does the price range vary between $235 and $335?
faqs.a: The final cost depends on how long the job takes, generally 2 to 3 hours at $100 per hour. Homes needing a new fan-rated box or additional wiring take longer than a straightforward swap of one fan for another.
